name: @airo-js-examples/lynx-native
description: An airo-js cartridge's server-rendered pages as native Lynx UI: @airo-js/lynx/build normalises the CSS, @airo-js/lynx/runtime mounts the HTML and runs the hydrate handlers through the DOM facade. The pages come from an in-bundle stand-in for the server, so the card runs with no backend.
